name: Seed Shrimp (Ostracoda sp.)
description: Seed Shrimp are tiny crustaceans named for the hard shell that covers them like a seed. They are an important part of aquatic food webs and are eaten by animals ranging from small fish to giant whale sharks. Seed Shrimp have existed for over 200 million years, with fossils showing they have changed very little over time.
characteristics: Form the base of marine food chains
Eat algae, bacteria, and other microscopic creatures
